messages:
ryan_csm: Quick sync on StormTech — onboarding mostly done but we're seeing ~3x the expected token cost and occasional p95 latency spikes. Renewal in ~45 days, CS flagged as at-risk unless we can show cost/latency wins. Any low-risk ops we can push quickly?

maria_cs: FYI their traffic is lots of short extraction prompts and chunked embedding lookups. High QPS, many repeated prefixes.

aj_devops: Quick list of pragmatic options (low dev effort first):
- Quantization: try int8 or q4_0 builds for the heavy batch endpoints. Typically 20–40% cost win with tiny quality loss for extraction tasks.
- Model swap: offer a smaller tuned variant for non-critical routes (e.g., 7B/redwood-optimized) and keep the 13B for high-quality routes.
- Routing: route low-priority / high-batch requests to a cost-optimized pool, route interactive sessions to fast-low-latency pool.
- KV/prefix caching: enable per-customer KV cache for repeated doc prefixes — huge win for their pattern.

Example canary config we can push:```yaml
canary: 10%
model_routes:
  - route: "/extract"
    model: "redwood/llama-13b-int8"
    pool: "dedicated-cost"
    quantization: "int8"
  - route: "/summarize"
    model: "redwood/vicuna-7b-q4"
    pool: "fast-low-latency"
    quantization: "q4_0"
fallback_policy: "previous-model"
quality_checks: ["accuracy_delta < 1%", "latency_p95 < 350ms"]
```

kevin_se: I can run their prompt set through our eval harness. Suggest acceptance criteria: accuracy degradation <1% on the annotated set and latency improvement >=20% on p95. I'll post results.

olivia_sre: Rollout ops: can do canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on metric breach. We should schedule during their low-traffic window and enable detailed tracing for the first 24h.

ops-bot: Deployment job created: <https://ci.redwood.internal/job/dep-7832> (canary: 10%).

ryan_csm: Sounds good. Tentative plan: Kevin runs eval this afternoon, Aj prepares canary config, Olivia schedules the rollout for Tue 10:00 PT. Maria will draft enablement note for the customer explaining tradeoffs. I’ll update the renewal RAG to amber for now.

maria_cs: One more nuance from the customer call — they care more about consistent p95 than marginal quality of long summaries. So emphasize routing + caching first, then quantize/swap if needed.

aj_devops: Agreed. If caching + routing gets us 30% cost savings, we can avoid a model swap. If not, try q4_0 on the extract route first.

kevin_se: Eval job queued as #4871. I’ll share the report here when done with side-by-side examples. @ryan_csm @maria_cs

ryan_csm: Thanks all — please tag me on the report. I’ll prep the customer note and propose the Tue window. :thumbsup:
